assertions.claim: The graph has exactly the five real File-input nodes in the same committed step
Exactly five graph edges leave film, one to input 0 of each consumer in this step
film is a File Root with the relative input basename and the node-File media rule
The formally published File root object is publicly readable
The File DSL publishes the actual bytes of the campaign input relative to launch.cwd
Reverse lookup by the graph's File content locator lists this run and its film binding
The search workload contains the exact Chinese scalar string as a root atom, not File metadata
A Chinese substring search hits this run's complete Chinese root value
The same Chinese substring search hits this run's complete committed step code
